svg.aria-label: The migration path: check with orange doctor, prepare the Worker, deploy it to Cloudflare, deploy to Rivet, move D1, point DNS at Rivet, backfill, then clean up. Traffic moves when you point DNS. Skip step 5 without D1, and step 7 without Durable Objects.
